kammavagga.p: [Kamma+vagga] (pu) CL=7 Kammavagga. A collection of Kamma. All of the sum of four Kamma. That is Apalokanakamma((Vinaya) legal procedure to obtain permission; the act of giving notice), ñattikamma((Vinaya) legal procedure with one motion; legal action with only an initial statement), Uttidutiyakamma, and ñatticatutthakamma ((Vinaya) legal procedure with motion and three announcements).
pn: Kammavagga. The twenty-fourth chapter of the Catukkanipāta of the Aṅguttaranikāya. It contains ten Suttas on various kinds of deeds, the four classes of ascetics and the blessings of a good man (AN.ii.230-9). The Commentary calls it Maggavagga.

kammavaṭṭa.p: [Kamma+vaṭṭa] (pu,na) CL=7 Kamma that arises the fruit (or) result of Kamma (as a circle). The continuity of Kamma. A round of Kamma. (As well the present willing that is being as an action which is a cause for rebirth-linking of the next existence, as well the rebirth-linking of present existence that arose due to intention in the past, these are called Kammavaṭṭa (round of Kamma (or) phase of Kamma). The five factors of Avijjā (illusion), Saṅkhāra (volitional formation), Taṇhā (craving), Upādāna (clinging), and Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence) that arise with companions. That is the so-called Kammavaṭṭa ( round of kamma (or) phase of kamma)).
